Senior Full-Stack Engineer

Acme Analytics | Remote (EU/US timezones) | Full-time

About the role
We are looking for a senior full-stack engineer to join the Pulse ingestion squad. You will design, build and operate the services that collect product telemetry from over a thousand engineering teams, and the React front end their teams live in every day.

What you will do
- Build and operate high-throughput TypeScript services on Node.js (Kafka ingestion, funnel APIs)
- Ship polished React front ends for funnel exploration and alerting
- Model and evolve PostgreSQL schemas handling billions of events
- Own services end to end: commit, deploy, on-call (one week in eight)
- Mentor mid-level engineers through design reviews and pairing

What we require (must have)
- 5+ years of professional experience building production web applications
- Strong TypeScript and modern React experience
- Solid Node.js backend experience: streaming, queues, REST APIs
- Hands-on PostgreSQL experience: schema design, query tuning, migrations
- Experience deploying and operating services on AWS
- You write tests as a matter of course and have worked with CI/CD pipelines
- Clear written communication in an async, remote-first culture

Nice to have
- Experience with Kafka or other streaming systems
- Kubernetes in production
- GraphQL API design
- Experience mentoring junior engineers formally

Compensation
Salary band for this role is published in our handbook. We pay for take-home time if you ask.

We are hiring a developer.
Apply now.
